description:
The Utility Based Handicrafts Award is a significant initiative by the Government of India aimed at promoting and recognizing the craftsmanship of artisans engaged in utility-based handicrafts. 

This scheme was launched in the year 2002 under the Ministry of Textiles. 

The primary objective of the Utility Based Handicrafts Award is to encourage artisans to innovate and create utility-based products that can cater to both domestic and international markets. 

The scheme aims to enhance the income of artisans by providing them with a platform to showcase their skills and products. 

The award seeks to promote the use of traditional handicraft techniques while ensuring that the products are functional and marketable. 

The specific goals of the scheme include increasing the production of utility-based handicrafts by at least 20 percent annually. 

Additionally, the scheme aims to provide recognition to at least 500 artisans every year through various awards and incentives. 

The benefits of the Utility Based Handicrafts Award include financial assistance and recognition for artisans who excel in creating utility-based products. 

Artisans selected for the award receive a cash prize of INR 1 lakh. 

In addition to the cash prize, awardees are also provided with a certificate of merit. 

The scheme also facilitates exposure to national and international markets for the artisans through exhibitions and trade fairs. 

Eligibility criteria for the Utility Based Handicrafts Award include being an artisan engaged in the production of utility-based handicrafts. 

There are no specific age limits for applicants. 

Artisans must demonstrate a proficiency in traditional handicraft techniques and the ability to create functional products. 

Income criteria are not strictly defined but preference is given to artisans from economically weaker sections. 

The application process for the Utility Based Handicrafts Award involves several steps. 

Interested artisans must fill out an application form available on the official website of the Ministry of Textiles. 

The application form requires details such as the artisan's name, address, and a description of the handicrafts produced. 

Applicants must also submit photographs of their utility-based products along with the application. 

A panel of experts evaluates the applications based on creativity, functionality, and craftsmanship. 

The evaluation process typically takes place annually, with applications being accepted from January to March each year. 

The awards are announced in the month of August during the National Handicrafts Fair. 

Disbursement of the cash prize occurs shortly after the announcement of the awards. 

The implementing authority for the Utility Based Handicrafts Award is the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. 

The Handicrafts Development Commissioner under the Ministry oversees the implementation of the scheme. 

For further information, artisans can contact the Handicrafts Development Commissioner’s office at the Ministry of Textiles, New Delhi. 

The contact details for the office include a telephone number and an email address which can be found on the official Ministry of Textiles website. 

The Utility Based Handicrafts Award not only provides financial benefits but also aims to enhance the skills of artisans through training programs. 

Workshops and training sessions are organized to help artisans improve their techniques and learn about market trends. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of sustainable practices in handicraft production. 

Artisans are encouraged to use eco-friendly materials in their products. 

Statistical data indicates that the Utility Based Handicrafts Award has benefited over 2,000 artisans since its inception. 

The scheme has played a crucial role in reviving traditional crafts and ensuring their relevance in contemporary markets. 

It has also contributed to the preservation of cultural heritage by promoting traditional craftsmanship. 

The award has gained recognition both nationally and internationally, enhancing the visibility of Indian handicrafts. 

Artisans who have received the award often report an increase in demand for their products following the recognition. 

The Utility Based Handicrafts Award has also fostered collaborations between artisans and designers. 

These collaborations have led to innovative product designs that appeal to modern consumers. 

The scheme aligns with the broader objectives of the Government of India to promote 'Make in India' and support local artisans. 

By focusing on utility-based products, the award encourages artisans to create items that meet consumer needs. 

The initiative has also contributed to the economic empowerment of women artisans, who form a significant portion of the handicraft workforce. 

Women artisans often face additional challenges in accessing markets and resources. 

The Utility Based Handicrafts Award helps to level the playing field by providing equal opportunities for recognition and support. 

In recent years, the scheme has expanded its outreach to include artisans from remote and rural areas. 

This expansion aims to ensure that artisans from all regions of India can benefit from the award. 

The Government of India continues to assess and refine the Utility Based Handicrafts Award to enhance its effectiveness. 

Feedback from artisans and stakeholders is regularly solicited to improve the scheme. 

The Utility Based Handicrafts Award is a vital component of India's efforts to promote handicrafts as a sustainable livelihood option. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to create a vibrant ecosystem for handicraft production and marketing. 

The scheme serves as a model for similar initiatives aimed at supporting traditional crafts globally. 

Overall, the Utility Based Handicrafts Award represents a commitment to preserving India's rich cultural heritage while fostering economic growth and innovation. 

Artisans are encouraged to participate actively in the scheme to maximize their benefits and contribute to the handicraft sector. 

The ongoing success of the Utility Based Handicrafts Award is a testament to the resilience and creativity of Indian artisans. 

The scheme continues to evolve in response to changing market dynamics and the needs of artisans. 

In conclusion, the Utility Based Handicrafts Award is an essential initiative that not only recognizes talent but also empowers artisans to thrive in a competitive market.
